name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for a small business website?
description: AEO optimizes for AI-driven search engines and user intent, while traditional SEO focuses on keywords and backlinks for conventional search algorithms.

mainEntity.name: How does AEO differ from traditional SEO for a small business website?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both AEO and SEO aim to improve online visibility, their approaches differ significantly. Traditional SEO focuses on optimizing for keyword rankings, backlinks, and technical aspects understood by conventional search engine algorithms. AEO, however, emphasizes optimizing for user intent, conversational queries, and the semantic understanding of content by AI engines and voice assistants. It considers factors like entity recognition, contextual relevance, and the ability of AI to synthesize information for direct answers. For a small business, AEO means preparing your online presence for the evolving landscape of AI-powered search, which can lead to better performance in voice search and featured snippets.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO optimizes for AI-driven search engines and user intent, while traditional SEO focuses on keywords and backlinks for conventional search algorithms.
